scope: Offline callback and source audit; no ROS master, hardware, driver or map threshold changes.
historical_occurrence: No matching delta-without-cache or malformed-snapshot error found in recent Nov10 navigation stutter/rear, 19:25 recorder or latest ROS logs. This is a reproduced design defect, not proven cause of those recorded stops.

before.malformed_same_generation: on_snapshot discarded both executable snapshot and field cache; every later valid delta also failed until a full packet arrived.
before.dropped_new_full: A queued full packet followed by delta can lose the full under latest-only queues; subsequent deltas must remain rejected until a full of their generation arrives.
before.recovery_bound: Next changed-generation full or existing 1-second resend, whichever arrives first. Recorded changed field frequency around5-6Hz; do not claim1second outage on every loss.
before.amplification: Raw decode error propagated from capture was not a local retry, so an active delivered navigation goal received tracking_fault despite no new geometric failure.

after.retained_cache: One last-successful decoded field retained separately; invalid current packet still clears executable self.snapshot. Only matching version/grid deltas may reuse cache.
after.fault_classification: Missing/decode-failed snapshot uses collision_snapshot_unavailable local retry; still stops base and publishes raw input_error diagnostics without cancelling the valid reference.
after.unchanged_limits: All source TTL, enabled perception health, map-version/grid equality, collision and stopping checks unchanged.
after.remaining_limitation: Missing a new-generation full still waits for a full packet; no ACK/resend subsystem was added.

related_audit.lost_track_id: DynamicPointBuffer now accepts latest valid real empty frame; old-ID recovery is not current runtime logic.
related_audit.map_latency: Recorded before-first-arm-stop map ages median228.987ms p95344.917ms vs350ms gate; 143/3139 packets exceeded gate at recorder. Pipeline stage attribution cannot prove raw sensor latency or immutable copies dominant.
related_audit.slow_layer_speed_guard: Native-reference collision can impose monotone speed guard on MPPI; preserve emergency priority until alternative-path safety arbitration is validated. Not changed in this patch.
